name: Glen Industries Ltd
title: Glen Industries Ltd - 544444 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Glen is adding ~3x plastic food-container capacity and paper food packaging (~750 MT, INR130-135 cr capex, INR500 cr turnover target by FY28) while PLA/paper straw utilisation is only 28-34% and EBITDA margin has compressed to 18-19% on pass-through of PLA costs.

utilisation.quote: healthy capacity utilization of approximately 77.74% for thin-wall food containers, 28.33% and 34.13% for PLA straws and paper straws respectively

capex.quote: now the project cost has risen from what we were anticipating earlier, it will be around INR130 to INR135 crores

triggers.label: Capex raised INR100 cr → INR130-135 cr
triggers.quote: now the project cost has risen from what we were anticipating earlier, it will be around INR130 to INR135 crores

triggers.label: Inventory 5-5.5 months vs 4 normal
triggers.quote: Today, it may be around 5-5.5 months.

triggers.label: Straw utilisation capped ~35%
triggers.quote: I don't think it can go beyond 35%. If I average out the total yearly demand, it will never exceed 35 %.

triggers.label: Food container price pass-through monthly
triggers.quote: we instantly pass on the prices to our export customer and domestic customer both way, upward or downward

guidance.quote: FY28 we are targeting for 500 plus turnover with the EBITDA of 90 plus.
Our sustainable margin is between 18% to 19%.

guidance.value: from September 2026, fully operational by Dec 2026
guidance.quote: we expect that the project will be starting commercial production from September.

guidance.metric: FY27 incremental revenue from new capacity
guidance.quote: We are expecting between INR100 crores to INR125 crores which will be contributing in the financial year FY26 - '27.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we wanted to establish the new capacity in the Quarter 1, but you know, due to SIR and due to elections in West Bengal

red_flags.label: Inventory 5-5.5 months, receivables/working capital rising
red_flags.quote: Today, it may be around 5-5.5 months.

red_flags.label: EBITDA margin 24% FY25 to 18-19% FY26; PAT down
Land parcel still mortgaged; sale plan unresolved
red_flags.quote: that is actually still mortgaged to bank

red_flags.label: Capex overrun with FX-driven cost increase
red_flags.quote: the currency fluctuation, which has gone from 85, 86 to now 87 to now it is 96

evasions.topic: Ask for EBITDA per kg disclosure
evasions.quote: So, we have to look into the statistics of same, whether it is viable or not and whether it is feasible or not.
We have a lot of plans, but right now I don't want to disclose them.
No, no, we are not making any further capex.
